name: Roofing
pain: storm-season call surges, insurance-job paperwork, and estimates that die without follow-up
systems: storm-response landing pages, financing calculators, drone-photo galleries, and automated estimate follow-up

name: Plumbing
pain: emergency calls at 2am, dispatch chaos, and homeowners who call the next Google result when you miss
systems: 24/7 AI call answering, emergency-service pages that rank, membership-plan billing, and dispatch-ready job intake

name: HVAC
pain: brutal seasonality, maintenance-agreement churn, and price-shopping homeowners
systems: seasonal campaign automation, maintenance-agreement portals, IAQ upsell content, and instant-quote tools

name: Electrical
pain: low-margin service calls mixed with big-ticket panel and EV work that never gets marketed
systems: EV-charger and panel-upgrade landing pages, permit-ready quote forms, and Google LSA dialed to licensed-trade requirements

name: Solar
pain: long sales cycles, incentive confusion, and lead vendors reselling the same homeowner five times
systems: savings calculators, incentive explainers kept current, financing pre-qual flows, and owned-lead funnels

name: Concrete
pain: bid-and-forget quoting, weather-driven scheduling, and portfolios trapped in a phone camera roll
systems: project galleries that sell, square-footage estimate tools, and booking flows built around pour windows

name: Landscaping
pain: one-off mows instead of contracts, spring rushes, and route-density economics nobody's website understands
systems: recurring-contract funnels, neighborhood-targeted campaigns, and seasonal service reminders that fill routes

name: Pest Control
pain: national franchises buying every keyword and one-time jobs that should be quarterly plans
systems: plan-first service pages, local-pest content that outranks the nationals, and subscription billing flows

name: Garage Doors
pain: lead brokers dominating emergency searches and repair calls that never turn into replacement sales
systems: same-day repair pages that rank, visual door configurators, and repair-to-replace nurture campaigns

name: Painting
pain: free-estimate tire kickers, seasonal interior/exterior swings, and referral pipelines that dry up
systems: instant ballpark calculators, before/after galleries, and neighborhood farming campaigns

name: Remodeling
pain: long projects, high-ticket decisions made on trust, and portfolios that undersell the craft
systems: project case-study pages, design-build process explainers, and financing-ready consultation funnels

name: Fencing
pain: drive-by quoting, material price swings, and zero repeat business without a system
systems: instant footage-based estimates, material comparison pages, and neighbor-referral automation

name: Excavation
pain: feast-or-famine bid work and GCs who only call the operators they remember
systems: capability pages that win bid lists, project galleries, and GC-relationship nurture campaigns

name: Tree Service
pain: storm spikes, insurance documentation, and danger-tree emergencies going to whoever answers first
systems: storm-response pages, 24/7 AI answering, and assessment-request flows with photo upload

name: Flooring
pain: showroom foot traffic dying while big-box stores buy the search results
systems: product visualizers, in-home consult booking, and local SEO that beats the big boxes

name: Gutters
pain: tiny average tickets unless installs, guards, and cleaning plans get sold as a system
systems: seasonal cleaning-plan funnels, gutter-guard upsell pages, and route-based scheduling

name: Construction
pain: referral dependence, bid-race margins, and a web presence that doesn't match the quality of the work
systems: portfolio sites that win trust, pre-qualification intake flows, and reputation engines

name: Real Estate
pain: portal dependence, database neglect, and marketing that stops the day the listing closes
systems: IDX-free agent sites that rank, listing marketing engines, and database reactivation campaigns — the stack I run in my own real-estate business
